useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

title:
{@link MlSymmetricMeanAbsolutePercentageErrorMetric Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (sMAPE)} metric
computes the average absolute percentage error between the predicted value and target value relative to the sum of
absolute values of predicted and target values. It is defined as follows:

$\text{SMAPE} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{t=1}^n \frac{\left\vert y_t - \hat{y}_t \right\vert}{\left\vert y_t \right\vert + \left\vert \hat{y}_t \right\vert}$

This metric is primarily used in regression, specifically for forecasting problems, where under-forecasting and
over-forecasting are equally damaging. In such cases {@link MlMeanAbsolutePercentageErrorMetric MAPE} does not
provide an accurate assessment of the error. This reformulation caps both under-forecasting and over-forecasting
to 100% and adjusts the metric to be symmetric.

The `modelOutput` and `targetOutput` are expected to have the same shape.
This metric supports `sampleWeights` as `context`. `sampleWeights` is single-dimensional with same number of samples
as the `modelOutput`. It represents a per-sample weighting when aggregating for sMAPE calculation.
name: MlSymmetricMeanAbsolutePercentageErrorMetric
